items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: "Big Sleepy," Thomas Grider, one of the trumpet players he was always sleeping

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

with his steps, "Big Sleepy," Thomas Grider, one of the trumpet players he was always sleeping, would sleep anywhere and during the soft shoe where nothing but piano music was -- drums were playing rushes on there, snare drums, Sleepy fell asleep and he dropped his horn all the way down to the main floor. The band was elevated. What a crash that made with the trumpet and Bill Robinson was all flustered and you can imagine how Bill Robinson felt.
